content.text:
这条红色警告**不是“你们的 Play 应用还没注册”**。我已用当前登录的 Play Console 核对过：`Medical Service` 账号里的 Play 应用已经全部注册完成，不需要为这条通知改 `csx-web` 代码。

## 结论

账号 **Medical Service**（Account ID `5010709474906912235`，组织 **Heals Healthcare (Asia) Limited**）已经满足 [Android developer verification](https://developer.android.com/developer-verification/guides/google-play-console) 对 **Google Play 应用** 的要求。

Play Console 首页原文是：

> All of your apps have been successfully registered to meet Android developer verification requirements.

[Android developer verification](https://play.google.com/console/u/1/developers/5010709474906912235/android-developer-verification) 页也一致：

- **Identity**：已带出组织名和香港地址，无需再做身份验证
- **Package names**：16 个全部是 `Registered`
- **Draft**：No results
- **In review**：No results

截图里 9 月 9 日那条，是 Google 发给所有开发者的政策提醒，不是单独针对这个账号的失败状态。按 [Play 软件包名称注册说明](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/16984799?hl=zh-Hans)，未在 **2026-09-30** 前注册的 Play 应用才会被全球下架。你们当前不在这个风险里。

通知确认无误后，可以在铃铛里点垃圾桶删掉；删通知不会改变注册状态。

## 16 个已注册包名

| 应用 | 包名 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CS Mobile | `asia.docnet.mobile` | Registered |
| CS Mobile Malaysia | `asia.docnet.mobile.malaysia` | Registered |
| Amber Group Medical Services | `com.ambermedicalapp` | Registered |
| CricleApp | `com.circleapp.cdvs` | Registered |
| CS Mobile | `com.csx.mobile.app` | Registered |
| Heals | `com.heals.healtheasyapp` | Registered |
| Amber Group Medical Services | `com.healshealthcare.ambermedical` | Registered |
| Heals Healthcare Patient App | `com.healshealthcare.app` | Registered |
| HealthEasy 康2健 | `com.healshealthcare.app.healtheasy` | Registered |
| Health Easy (Dev) | `com.healshealthcare.app.healtheasy.dev` | Registered |
| DSi-con | `com.healshealthcare.dahsinginsurance` | Registered |
| Heals | `com.healshealthcare.healspass` | Registered |
| Heals (Dev) | `com.healshealthcare.healspass.dev` | Registered |
| Heals | `com.healshealthcare.healtheasyapp` | Registered |
| Heals Patient App | `com.healshealthcare.patientapp` | Registered |
| 新都醫療 | `com.newTownMedical` | Registered |

每个包目前都只有 **1 把 key**，这通常表示 Google 已用 Play 上的签名信息自动注册完成。

## 还需要人工确认的两件事

Google 这条提醒还覆盖 **Play 站外** 场景。如果下面任一情况属实，才需要再点一次 **Register package name / Add key**：

1. 同一 Play 应用还用**另一把签名密钥**在 Play 外分发，例如 Galaxy Store、华为、官网 APK、企业内部包。
2. 有 Android 应用**从未上过这个 Play 账号**，但仍要装到认证 Android 设备上。

只走 Google Play、且只用 Play App Signing 这一把正式签名密钥，就不用再注册。

## 另一条更紧急的通知

同一通知中心里还有一条 **HealthEasy 康2健**：要求在 **2026-08-31** 前更新 target API level。今天已是 2026-09-14，这条比刚才那条更值得优先处理。需要的话我可以继续帮你查这个应用的 targetSdk 和上架状态。

**Daily Report — 14 Sep 2026**  
**Item:** Google Play Console — Android developer verification notice (Medical Service)

**Background**  
Reviewed a critical Play Console Home notification dated 9 Sep 2026 for developer account **Medical Service** (Account ID `5010709474906912235`). The notice required apps to be registered for Android developer verification by **30 Sep 2026**, warning that unregistered Play apps would be removed from Google Play globally, and that unregistered apps from other participating stores would no longer be installable on certified Android devices in selected countries (Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand as the first wave).

The notice asked developers to open the Android developer verification page and register:
1. Play apps  
2. Any additional signing keys used to sign those apps outside Play  
3. Any Android apps distributed outside Play  

Official references checked: [Register on Google Play Console](https://developer.android.com/developer-verification/guides/google-play-console), [Registering Play package names](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/16984799?hl=en), and [Play Console requirements](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10788890).

**Work done**  
Logged into the live Play Console Home (`/app-list`) and the Android developer verification page for this account. Cross-checked:
- Home-page registration banner and notification center copy  
- Identity tab vs Settings > Developer account > Account details  
- Package-name list (all 16 rows, both pages)  
- Status filters: **Draft** and **In review**  

**Findings**  
This is a **global policy reminder**, not an account-level registration failure. No Play Console action, code change, or release is required for Play-listed apps.

Home already showed: **“All of your apps have been successfully registered to meet Android developer verification requirements.”**

Identity is already populated from the Play developer account:
- Account type: Organization  
- Developer name: Medical Service  
- Organization: Heals Healthcare (Asia) Limited  
- Address: 18/F China Taiping Tower Phase 1, 8 Sunning Road, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong  
- Account owner: `heals.dev@gmail.com` (Ben Li)  

Package-name registration:
- **16 / 16 Registered**  
- **Draft: No results**  
- **In review: No results**  
- Each package currently has **1 registered signing key**, consistent with Google auto-registering the Play signing information  

Registered packages:
- CS Mobile — `asia.docnet.mobile`  
- CS Mobile Malaysia — `asia.docnet.mobile.malaysia`  
- Amber Group Medical Services — `com.ambermedicalapp`  
- CricleApp — `com.circleapp.cdvs`  
- CS Mobile — `com.csx.mobile.app`  
- Heals — `com.heals.healtheasyapp`  
- Amber Group Medical Services — `com.healshealthcare.ambermedical`  
- Heals Healthcare Patient App — `com.healshealthcare.app`  
- HealthEasy 康2健 — `com.healshealthcare.app.healtheasy`  
- Health Easy (Dev) — `com.healshealthcare.app.healtheasy.dev`  
- DSi-con — `com.healshealthcare.dahsinginsurance`  
- Heals — `com.healshealthcare.healspass`  
- Heals (Dev) — `com.healshealthcare.healspass.dev`  
- Heals — `com.healshealthcare.healtheasyapp`  
- Heals Patient App — `com.healshealthcare.patientapp`  
- 新都醫療 — `com.newTownMedical`  

**Conclusion**  
Play apps under this account already meet the 30 Sep 2026 Android developer verification requirement. The 9 Sep red notice can be dismissed/deleted in the notification center; deleting it does not change registration status.

**Residual check (not blocking this notice)**  
Further registration is only needed if we later confirm either of the following:
- A Play app is also signed with a **different key** for distribution outside Play (e.g. other stores, website APK, internal builds)  
- An Android app is distributed **outside this Play account** and still needs to be installable on certified devices  

**Note (out of scope today)**  
The same notification center also has a separate critical item for **HealthEasy 康2健**: update target API level by **31 Aug 2026**. That deadline has already passed and should be scheduled separately.
